summary: Retested record-inspector backdrop fix on /admin/market/evidence. All targeted behaviors pass: backdrop has computed pointer-events:none, clicking a different row while inspector is open switches the record (verified across 3 rows: 'House · Boroko' -> 'Apartment · Kokopo' -> 'Apartment · Ela Beach') without closing the inspector; ESC closes; X (inspector-close) closes. Iter-38 regression items all still pass: table headers exactly [Record ID, Source, Purpose, Class, Location, Price, Last Seen, Status]; all six inspector-group-* testids present; all required fields present under inspector-field-* prefix (allotment-number, section-number, portion-number, bedrooms, bathrooms, land-area-m2, building-area-m2, street, local-area, city, province, source-id-full, listing-url, property-subtype); inspector-source-url anchor has target=_blank; inspector-raw-toggle expands inspector-raw-body.
seed_data_creation: None; used existing seeded evidence rows (100 present).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Inspector fields use `inspector-field-<slug>` naming (slug lowercases label; ² becomes 2, so 'Land area (m²)' -> 'inspector-field-land-area-m2'). Backdrop has pointer-events:none by design — row-click-through is intentional. Close paths: ESC and inspector-close only.
rca_of_the_issue: Prior iter-38/39 defect: full-viewport backdrop intercepted clicks so users couldn't row-switch. Fix in Evidence.jsx line 186 applies pointer-events-none to the backdrop div, so pointer events fall through to the underlying table rows, enabling row-switch UX while keeping ESC/X as explicit close paths.
